# Device Monitoring Checklist: MIDI Device List

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and operational quality of the MIDI
device monitoring requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on
feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are initial enumeration, connection, disconnection, and reconnection
  requirements all explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define the complete supported endpoint scope, including
  both MIDI 1 and MIDI 2 devices and excluded endpoint categories? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK003 Are read-only scope boundaries and excluded routing/device actions documented?
  [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Are user-visible loading, ready, empty, degraded, unavailable, and stopped
  states defined consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-010, Data Model §Device Overview]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the meaning of “device” unambiguously defined as an endpoint, including
  the identity used for uniqueness? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §MIDI Device]
- [x] CHK006 Are the exact user-facing labels for MIDI 1, MIDI 2, and unknown version
  states specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §MIDI Version]
- [x] CHK007 Is the “within 2 seconds” update target clearly tied to detection and visible
  publication rather than an unspecified internal event? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is deterministic ordering of entries specified sufficiently for both users and
  requirements reviewers? [Clarity, Data Model §Device Overview]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are the requirements for preserving valid entries during an update failure
  consistent with the defined degraded status? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Do the one-entry-per-endpoint rule and duplicate-name behavior consistently
  distinguish identity from display name? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are the SDK filter decision, MIDI version classification, and feature scope
  aligned without implying that translated ports are separate devices? [Consistency, Plan §Summary, Research §Decisions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can the 100% initial completeness and uniqueness criterion be evaluated against
  a defined set of connected supported endpoints? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK013 Is the 95th-percentile two-second update criterion accompanied by a clear
  definition of the observed event population? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK014 Are the success criteria traceable to the functional requirements and primary
  user journeys rather than only to implementation details? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001-005]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are alternate scenarios for no devices, duplicate display names, and unknown
  versions explicitly specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Are exception requirements complete for service unavailability, initial
  enumeration failure, and per-endpoint information read failure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK017 Are rapid or reordered connection events covered with an explicit final-state
  and stale-update rule? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Event Semantics]
- [x] CHK018 Are recovery requirements defined for returning from degraded or unavailable
  state after a later successful reconciliation? [Gap, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are concurrency requirements explicit about callback duration, serialized
  updates, queue bounds, coalescing, and stale snapshot prevention? [Completeness, Plan §Constraints, Research §Decision]
- [x] CHK020 Are shutdown and cancellation requirements clear enough to prevent updates
  after the application has stopped? [Reliability, Contract §Event Semantics]
- [x] CHK021 Are logging requirements specific about stable event names, exception capture,
  diagnostic identifiers, and user-facing information boundaries? [Observability, Contract §Logging Contract]
- [x] CHK022 Are test-environment requirements explicit that automated validation must not
  require physical MIDI hardware? [Testability, Plan §Testing, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Are accessibility, localization, and wording requirements for list entries and
  status messages addressed or explicitly bounded? [Gap, Spec §FR-002-003]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Are Windows MIDI Services availability and the supported Windows environment
  documented as verifiable prerequisites? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Target Platform]
- [x] CHK025 Is the discrepancy between the README’s .NET 8 statement and the project’s
  current target explicitly resolved before implementation? [Conflict, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK026 Is the stable endpoint identity assumption validated for reconnect behavior
  and identity changes? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §MIDI Device]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state but does not modify markers.
- This is a requirements-quality checklist; it does not verify implementation behavior.
